sketch:
Observe: SVG cross-section of the reduced eye — cornea+cristallin
modelled as a single lens of variable f', retina fixed at ~17 mm.
Student toggles between distant/near objects and drags a "muscle
tension" slider that changes f' (accommodation); image sharpness on
retina shown. Experiment: 3 seeded object distances (∞, 1 m, 25 cm);
student sets accommodation to focus each on the retina. Evaluate:
with "myope" / "hypermétrope" variants, student picks the corrective
lens (divergente / convergente) that restores focus at PR/PP —
blind to individual rays.
